summary: Batch 8 Tools UI QA (7 target admin/manager screens + 2 regression loads) at 1920x1080 as forest@imosapp.com. RESULT: All 7 target screens pass ScreenHeader + gold accent + testID standards. 0 iOS-blue elements on any target screen (nav/pills/tabs/buttons). All requested testids exist. Only issue: 1 em dash still visible on /settings/messaging-channels in a channel description ('Send via WhatsApp — most popular messaging app worldwide'). Source is backend static data (backend/routers/messaging_channels.py line 22), not frontend, but it renders in the UI and violates the 'no em dashes in visible text' rule. Batch 7 regression loads (/team, /campaigns/dashboard) still render their headers cleanly.

minor.issue: Channel description for whatsapp contains an em dash '—' which renders on /settings/messaging-channels and violates the no-em-dash UI rule. Replace with hyphen or comma.

ui_bugs.issue: 1 em dash '—' visible in the WhatsApp channel description card ('Send via WhatsApp — most popular messaging app worldwide'). Data comes from backend list endpoint (backend/routers/messaging_channels.py line 22), but per Batch 8 spec no em dashes should render.

action_items: In /app/backend/routers/messaging_channels.py line 22 change 'Send via WhatsApp — most popular messaging app worldwide' to use a hyphen/comma (e.g. 'Send via WhatsApp - most popular messaging app worldwide') to remove the last em dash on the Batch 8 messaging-channels screen.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 target Batch 8 screens correctly use the shared ScreenHeader with proper testids, back chevrons, centered 17/700 titles and gold right actions - no leaks of iOS blue (#007AFF).
Store Profile correctly falls back to a REAL empty state (store-profile-empty + store-profile-go-my-profile) for accounts with no store, matching the spec's 'real empty states' requirement.

Team Members list + Add Team Member modal + Team Member detail page + all 4 detail modals (change-role, dedicated-number, change-org, assign-store) render every expected testid; cancel labels are gray (not red/blue). No danger buttons were tapped.
Integrations tab switching (api-keys/webhooks/crm/dms/docs) works; crm-dashboard-link, crm-pin-toggle and swagger-link all present.
The remaining em-dash is backend-owned static data - consider a lint/CI rule to grep for '—' across both backend static strings and frontend source to prevent future regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on structure/testids/gold-theming/no-blue for all 7 Batch 8 targets. 1 minor content issue (em dash from backend data).
